g.text: Hypothetical fixed-temperature ideal liquid/ideal gas mixture, no azeotrope. P_bubble=Σx_iP_i^sat; 1/P_dew=Σy_i/P_i^sat. Horizontal tie line connects
equilibrium liquid and vapor compositions at the same pressure. The horizontal coordinate is a different phase composition on each curve.
